wins: Maintained disciplined reconnaissance schedule with Nmap + default script scans, capturing service banners within the allotted mentor call windows.
Captured consistent asset metadata that can seed follow-on exploit attempts despite not reaching final success.
fails: Failed to chain privilege escalation due to unexploited legacy kernel modules and lack of credential harvesting.
Zero success rate indicates no final objective achieved despite accumulating 50 reward, suggesting incomplete attack sequence execution.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed consistently, but the run terminated prior to privilege escalation and objective completion, highlighting gaps in exploitation follow-through.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalls when kernel privilege vectors are assumed present but not validated, leading to repeated dead-ends after successful initial enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted Nmap scripts and attempt default credential login via systematic dictionary.

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows host discovered with accessible SMB shares
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares with smbclient, extract file metadata, and pivot to credential harvesting using CrackMapExec.

skill_cards.if_condition: When web application response contains outdated framework signatures (e.g., Laravel 5.x)
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory brute force and review public exploits for inline file download or RCE patterns documented for that framework.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH reconnaissance phase within this run.
Effective for SMB enumeration that yielded actionable file metadata.
